input._script:
using JSON3
result = Dict{String,Any}("hostname" => gethostname())
println(stderr, "NODE: ", gethostname()); flush(stderr)
d = mktempdir(); f = joinpath(d, "diag.sh")
write(f, raw"""
set +e
source /scratch/coop/drozda/jax-env/bin/activate
SP=$(python -c "import site;print(site.getsitepackages()[0])")
echo "== declared requirements"
python - << 'EOF'
import importlib.metadata as md
for p in ("jax-cuda12-plugin", "jax-cuda12-pjrt", "jax", "jaxlib"):
    try:
        reqs = md.requires(p) or []
        print(p, md.version(p))
        for r in reqs:
            if any(k in r.lower() for k in ("cudnn", "nvidia", "cuda", "jax-cuda")): print("   ", r)
    except Exception as e:
        print(p, "ERR", e)
EOF
echo "== plugin cudnn version rules"
grep -n -i "cudnn" $SP/jax_plugins/xla_cuda12/__init__.py | head -20 | cut -c1-200
echo "== cudnn dist-info"
ls -d $SP/nvidia_cudnn_cu12*/ 2>/dev/null; cat $SP/nvidia_cudnn_cu12*/METADATA 2>/dev/null | grep -E "^(Version|Requires-Dist|Summary)" | head
echo "== pip can reach an index from a compute node?"
timeout 20 pip download nvidia-cudnn-cu12==9.10.2.21 --no-deps -d /tmp/x -q 2>&1 | tail -2 | cut -c1-200
""")
try
    out = IOBuffer(); err = IOBuffer()
    p = run(pipeline(ignorestatus(Cmd(`bash $f`; dir=d)), stdout=out, stderr=err))
    result["exit"] = p.exitcode
    result["diag"] = String(take!(out))
catch e
    result["error"] = sprint(showerror, e)
end
println(JSON3.write(result))
